title: 'The entire thing is going to fall apart:' Inside the latest round of mass layoffs at Xbox - Game Developer
title_zh: Xbox 再爆大規模裁員內幕：受影響員工揭露微軟殘酷真相
summary: Let's turn back the clock to Monday, July 6, when the layoffs were confirmed internally (and subsequently announced publicly) by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma. Multiple sources spread across Bethesda, ZeniMax Online Studios, and id Software were informed their jobs were being eliminated during a fleeting...
summary_zh: 微軟 Xbox 自 2023 年以來的第五波大規模裁員，影響橫跨 Bethesda、ZeniMax Online Studios 和 id Software 等多個工作室。匿名受訪員工控訴微軟以冷冰冰的短暫會議通知裁員，數百年的集體遊戲開發經驗在幾分鐘內被拋棄。報導深入揭露 Xbox CEO Asha Sharma 主導的這波裁員如何摧毀團隊士氣，也引發業界對遊戲大廠人力管理方式的強烈質疑。

title: Court orders Midgar Studio to liquidate after failing to secure a buyer - GamesIndustry.biz
title_zh: 法院命令 Midgar Studio 清算：《Edge of Eternity》開發商正式關閉
summary: Nacon subsidiaries Spiders, Kylotonn, Cyanide, and Nacon Tech filed for insolvency back in March. Midgar has followed Greedfall developer Spiders, which similarly shut down after failing to find a buyer.
summary_zh: 《Edge of Eternity》開發商 Midgar Studio 確定倒閉。法院在該公司未能找到買家後正式下令清算。創辦人 Jérémy Zeler-Maury 表示非常難過地說再見。此前 Nacon 旗下的 Spiders（《Greedfall》開發商）、Kylotonn、Cyanide 和 Nacon Tech 已於三月申請破產，Midgar 成為 Nacon 集團連鎖倒閉的最新犧牲者。Slitherine Software 已收購部分授權與發行權。

title: In An Era Of AI Slop, Meccha Chameleon Embraces Human-Crafted Chaos - GameSpot
title_zh: 在 AI 泛濫的時代，《Meccha Chameleon》擁抱人類親手打造的混亂
summary: Where creators used to make rough but charming placeholders, now they type a few words into a prompt without the discovery that comes from struggling through iterations. It is destructive for audiences, who are denied something genuine, and for artists, who are relying on a digital hallucination...
summary_zh: 在 AI 生成內容（AI Slop）充斥的當代，《Meccha Chameleon》選擇了一條截然不同的路——擁抱人類親自創作的混亂與真實。文章指出過去創作者會做出粗糙但充滿魅力的 placeholder，如今卻只輸入幾個字給 AI 提示詞，失去了從迭代掙扎中所獲得的發現過程。這不僅對觀眾而言剝奪了真實性，也讓藝術家淪為依賴數位幻覺的工具。這款遊戲的存在本身就是對 AI 時代的反思與抵抗。

title: Video Game Companies Can No Longer Do Layoffs Quietly - Kotaku
title_zh: 遊戲公司再也無法偷偷裁員了——開發者們不再默默忍受
summary: Labor conditions in the video game industry have sucked since 2021. Yet its decline in the last year, exacerbated by foundation-breaking layoffs at Epic, Xbox, and PlayStation have become too big to simply carry on business as usual.
summary_zh: 遊戲產業的勞動條件自 2021 年以來持續惡化，而 Epic、Xbox 和 PlayStation 等巨頭在過去一年內進行的顛覆性裁員，讓情況再也無法被忽視。報導指出遊戲開發者們正發起罷工、組織工會、公開抗議，不再默默接受被裁員的命運。從 Ubisoft 到 ZeniMax 的員工抗爭，預示著產業勞動關係正在發生結構性轉變。

title: Disco Elysium Dev ZA/UM Announces Layoffs Affecting Up to 32 Staff - IGN India
title_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 宣布裁員 32 人
summary: The 2020s have been rough for ZA/UM. Trouble truly began in early October 2022, when multiple key developers - including writer and designer Robert Kurvitz, writer Helen Hindpere, and art and design lead Aleksander Rostov - were said to have left the studio involuntarily.
summary_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 宣布裁員最多 32 名員工，距離其最新作品《Zero Parades: For Dead Spies》在五月推出並獲得「高度好評」僅兩個月。聲明指出雖然遊戲獲得評論界讚譽，但商業表現不如預期。自 2022 年多名核心開發者被迫離開後，ZA/UM 的困境持續擴大，這次裁員再次引發外界對這家曾經風光的工作室未來的擔憂。

title: Disco Elysium Dev ZA/UM Announces Layoffs 2 Months After Zero Parades Launched to Critical Acclaim - IGN
title_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 宣布裁員 新作獲好評兩個月後仍難逃縮編
summary: The 2020s have been rough for ZA/UM. Trouble truly began in early October 2022, when multiple key developers - including writer and designer Robert Kurvitz, writer Helen Hindpere, and art and design lead Aleksander Rostov - were said to have left the studio involuntarily.
summary_zh: ZA/UM 在最新作《Zero Parades: For Dead Spies》獲得評論界高度讚譽僅兩個月後，仍宣布裁員最多 32 人。英國總部發布聲明解釋商業表現未達預期是主要原因。這家曾以《極樂迪斯可》驚豔業界的工作室，自 2022 年核心團隊出走後風波不斷，如今再陷裁員泥沼，令人不勝唏噓。
